proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E472(e) Acetyltartaric Acid Glycerol Esters
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E472(e)/DATEM as Mushbooh (doubtful): it is esters of acetic acid, glycerol, tartaric acid and fatty acids, so the source of the glycerol and fatty acids (plant oil vs animal/pork fat) must be checked to determine halal status.

researcherNote: E472 seeded hanafiStrict grade 4 (widely avoided). SANHA mushbooh / verify source. One tier-1. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
